pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with predominantly sharp edge gradients. Patch spatial area is highest on the mid-flank and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more condensed geometries on the hindquarters and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space pathways forming distinct Y-junction and X-junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the flank and lower neck, maintaining high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a dark, short-bristled silhouette along the upper neck contour. The serration exhibits a high frequency of small spikes with low vertical amplitude against the background.
